Artificial intelligence is transforming many industries by enabling computers to perform tasks 
that previously required human intelligence.

One important part of AI is machine learning, which 
allows systems to improve their performance by analyzing data.
Different machine learning approaches are used depending on the problem being solved.

Some 
methods rely on labeled data to guide the learning process, while others attempt to discover 
patterns automatically without prior labeling.

Machine learning technology is now used in areas such as online recommendations, automated 
language translation, healthcare diagnostics, and smart transportation systems.

These 
technologies continue to evolve as more data and computing power become available.
